svg.desc: Minimum identity 7/9 · Target Coverage · Rows 1–50 of 32,686. One row per human–viral protein pair, including short human targets. Order defaults to target coverage, highest first. Parent coverage is also available. Percentages use each protein’s full length; pairs require at least 10% on either side. CSV downloads the complete summary at all three thresholds; PNG and SVG export this page.
